data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as an enemy unit (not a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit) is picked to make a [fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back).

**Target:** A **HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE** or **VASHTORR THE ARKIFANE** unit of yours in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of that unit.

**Effect:** Whenever an enemy unit (not a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit) in Engagement Range of the unit makes a fall-back move in the rest of the phase, every model in that enemy unit takes a [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape), with -1 to each test for a [battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) enemy unit.
